prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1083; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you confirm you're comfortable continuing?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe in your own words what happened on the day of the accident.

A: I was driving on the highway in Sugar Land, in the right lane. I wanted to move over to the left lane because I needed to exit a little further up. I checked my mirror, but I think I didn't check my blind spot well enough.

Q: What happened when you changed lanes?

A: The other car was in the left lane and it just clipped my side. We sideswiped each other. I heard a loud scrape and my car jerked toward the median.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began to move over?

A: I don't think I saw it clearly. It was there, but I didn't see it in time.

Q: Where were you injured?

A: My left wrist. I tried to grab the steering wheel and I landed on my wrist when the airbag went off. It hurt right away and I couldn't move my fingers properly.

Q: Did you seek medical treatment?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They X-rayed it and said it was fractured. I've been wearing a splint and I have a follow-up appointment with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Only that I'm sorry it happened. I want to cooperate fully and get everything sorted out.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with the documents we discussed. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
